seed.note: the forward pass itself has no randomness

prompt_template.system_prompt: none added; Aya's default preamble comes from the chat template

position: last prompt token (after the generation prompt)
dtype: float16 for the layers, bfloat16 embeddings; saved as float32
device_reason: 18 layers (2.8 GB) fit on NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (3.5 GB free)
